statement: Cerebras unveiled the CS-4, a rack-scale system of three WSE-3 Turbo wafers delivering 750 PFLOPS, with first shipments beginning this quarter.
why: A shipping non-GPU accelerator at rack scale is real alternative supply of AI compute that can absorb workloads otherwise queued for merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: A new rack-scale accelerator entering shipment adds non-GPU compute capacity to the market, offering an alternative path for inference workloads.

evidence.excerpt: introduced the CS-4, described as 'the fastest AI accelerator in the industry', a rack-scale system comprising three WSE-3 Turbo wafers. Performance claims: 750 PFLOPS of AI compute

confidence.basis: Vendor press release carried on a secondary aggregator; performance figures are unverified vendor claims.
